Event Details

Location: Unleashed Store for Cats & Dogs (North Raleigh) • 7408 Creedmoor Rd, Raleigh, NC 

Tickets: $35 each / https://givebutter.com/130pm-1025-class-unleashed-n-raleigh

All proceeds support Blazin' Trails Bottle Babies rescue puppies and the care they need to grow strong. 

👉 Tickets go fast and this one sells out quickly, so grab yours in advance. 

What to expect: A beginner-friendly yoga flow with rescue puppies roaming for cuddles, naps, and the best kind of distraction. 

Arrival: Come 5 minutes early to check in and set up your mat. 

What to bring: Yoga mat + water, comfy clothes, and a camera-ready smile. 

 All proceeds support Blazin' Trails Bottle Babies rescue puppies and the care they need to grow strong.
